description: This file defines a TaskRepository class for managing tasks in a database using Prisma ORM. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, retrying, and deleting tasks, as well as querying for specific task states like failed, succeeded, or upcoming tasks.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with task data in the database, including creation, retrieval, updating, retrying, and deletion of tasks.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new task with specified type, payload, and options.

methods.name: getNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of upcoming tasks scheduled to run.

methods.name: getFailed
methods.description: Retrieves tasks that have reached maximum attempts and failed.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of tasks.

methods.name: countUpcoming
methods.description: Returns the count of upcoming tasks scheduled to run.

methods.name: countFailed
methods.description: Returns the count of failed tasks.

methods.name: countSucceeded
methods.description: Returns the count of succeeded tasks.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Retries a task by incrementing attempts and optionally updating scheduled time.

methods.name: succeed
methods.description: Marks a task as succeeded and increments attempts.

methods.name: updatePayload
methods.description: Updates the payload of a specific task.

methods.name: cancelWithReference
methods.description: Deletes a task by reference UID and type, returns null if not found.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Placeholder for cleaning up tasks, currently commented out.

methods.name: hasNewerScanTaskForStepId
methods.description: Checks if there is a newer scan task for a given workflow step ID and creation time.
